Foam fractionation.question: The rate at which certain non-ionic molecules can adsorb to bubble surface can be estimated by solving the Ward-_____ equation
Foam fractionation.fact: The rate at which certain non-ionic molecules can adsorb to bubble surface can be estimated by solving the Ward-Tordai equation.

Foam fractionation.subject: Hydrology & Soil Conservation
Foam fractionation.question: The hydrodynamic condition is described by the Hydrodynamic Theory of _____
Foam fractionation.fact: The enrichment and recovery depend on the hydrodynamic condition of the rising foam, which is a complex system dependent upon bubble size distribution, stress state at the gas-liquid interface, rate of bubble coalescence, gas rate inter alia. The hydrodynamic condition is described by the Hydrodynamic Theory of Rising Foam.
